legal_units.title: Meaning of specified domestic transaction.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "specified domestic transaction" in case of an assessee means any of the following transactions (not being an international transaction),— and where the aggregate of such transactions entered into by the assessee in a tax year exceeds a sum of twenty crore rupees.
